short: ways: a Claude Code plugin marketplace of ways of working, plus the zaf binary
is: The ways repository: a Claude Code plugin marketplace (the teams, handoff and nodes packs under plugins/) and zaf, the Rust CLI the teams pack drives, with the framework's design draft under docs/.
conventions: One plugin per way of working; no plugin requires another (an optional integration is detected or offered, never required).
main is the release channel for the plugins: every commit on main is a new plugin version, so main stays shippable.
Branches (.zaf.toml): integration feature/{version}, task feature/{version}-{epic}-{task}; VCS is jj colocated with git.

The repo runs zaf on itself: .zaf.toml is its manifest and .zaf/actions holds its own actions; the full gate is `cd zaf && cargo fmt --check && cargo build && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test`.

fs.name: .forgejo/
fs.role: workflows Forgejo runs in place of .github's: zaf.yml (the gate on Linux alone) and zaf-release.yml (the musl binary on zaf-v* tags, published through Forgejo's API)

fs.name: .github/
fs.role: workflows: zaf.yml (gate on zaf/ changes) and zaf-release.yml (binaries on zaf-v* tags)

fs.name: .zaf.toml
fs.role: zaf's manifest for this repo: board, vcs, forge, gate, roles, runners, [forbidden] and [check.pr]

fs.name: .zaf/
fs.role: actions/ (this repo's own actions, the project tier) and .gitignore are committed; the rest is machine-local state

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: the marketplace manual: packs, install, updating, layout

fs.name: docs/
fs.role: zuri-ai-framework.md (the design draft), zaf-actions.md (the actions design, rulings of 2026-11-03, and what Claude assumed, the Forgejo board among it) and baseline-2026-10-27.md (teams 1.x measurements)

fs.name: zaf/
fs.role: the zaf Rust crate (Zuri's AI Framework CLI)

notes: To understand a path, load `nodes chain <path>`; `node: false` entries are fully described by their `fs` line.
The design page is docs/zuri-ai-framework.md (draft v0, 2026-10-27); .zaf.toml sets [design] kind = "repo-dir" over docs/, so `zaf ask` checks the keeper's quotes against those pages.
.zaf/'s machine-local state (asklog, guard, profiles, runs, slices, spawn state and workspaces) is git-ignored by .zaf/.gitignore, which allows only its own file, config.toml, actions/ and roles/.
Board and forge are GitHub issues and PRs on ProgrammingCheetah/ways (.zaf.toml).

Binary releases are tagged zaf-vX.Y.Z: zaf-release.yml checks zaf/Cargo.toml's version matches the tag, builds x86_64 musl Linux and aarch64 macOS, and uploads archives plus sha256 sums to a GitHub release.
The CI gate zaf.yml runs only when zaf/ or the workflow changes, on Ubuntu and macOS, after installing jj v0.46.0 because the Vcs adapter's tests drive a real jj.
